title: Bora Employer Pipeline Job Analysis Result
description: First vertical-slice structured output of analyze_job: requirements, evidence matches, gaps/unknowns, and inspectable lane/decision. Not a résumé patch and not a hire-probability score.

gaps.description: UNMIGRATED_EXTRACTION_AND_GOLDEN_COMPLETION_V1: a compatibility-NAME alias for `qualification_gaps` (the identical list object) -- kept for callers written before SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_QUALIFICATION_VIEW_V1. Its content is NOT preserved byte-for-byte relative to that milestone: a ROLE_RESPONSIBILITY/AMBIGUOUS/APPLICATION_OR_LEGAL_GATE requirement is now explicitly excluded, where it was previously included under deficiency framing. See `qualification_gaps` for the authoritative description.

unknowns.description: UNMIGRATED_EXTRACTION_AND_GOLDEN_COMPLETION_V1: a compatibility-NAME alias for `qualification_unknowns` (the identical list object); not byte-identical to its pre-milestone content. See `qualification_unknowns` for the authoritative description.

qualification_gaps.description: SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_QUALIFICATION_VIEW_V1 (authoritative name): unsupported (NONE) mandatory/preferred requirements whose derived qualification_gate is YES only. Never includes a ROLE_RESPONSIBILITY/AMBIGUOUS/APPLICATION_OR_LEGAL_GATE row. `gaps` is a compatibility-name alias for this exact field (same list object), not an independently-populated, pre-milestone-identical value.

qualification_unknowns.description: SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_QUALIFICATION_VIEW_V1 (authoritative name): UNKNOWN-result requirements whose derived qualification_gate is YES only. `unknowns` is a compatibility-name alias for this exact field (same list object), not an independently-populated, pre-milestone-identical value.

capability_inference_state.description: SOURCE_ROLE_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDED_CORRECTION_V1: distinguishes the matcher never recognizing any capability concept in this text (a much weaker 'no evidence' state) from capabilities being recognized but no approved Claim matching, from an established STRONG/SUPPORTED/PARTIAL match. Never collapses these into one undifferentiated absence claim.

responsibility_observations.description: SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_QUALIFICATION_VIEW_V1: every ROLE_RESPONSIBILITY (and AMBIGUOUS, since AMBIGUOUS never independently gates either) requirement, with its already-established match result and cited evidence/claim information, reported without qualification-deficiency language. Never a candidate-gap or candidate-weakness statement.

responsibility_evidence_unknowns.description: SOURCE_ROLE_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDED_CORRECTION_V1: responsibility rows (result=NONE/UNKNOWN with no cited evidence_ids/claim_ids at all) for which no established current approved match exists. Explicitly matcher-bounded wording -- never claims no adjacent evidence exists, that the candidate lacks the capability, or that this is a development need or qualification gap.

application_or_legal_gate_observations.description: SOURCE_ROLE_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDED_CORRECTION_V1: every APPLICATION_OR_LEGAL_GATE requirement, with proof (re-checked here, not merely asserted at classification time) that the named job_decision.py JD-text-level citizenship/clearance consumer actually covers it. Never redesigns application_gate.py or immigration/work-authorization logic.

unresolved_gate_observations.description: SOURCE_ROLE_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDED_CORRECTION_V1: a citizenship/clearance/work-authorization/legal-access requirement whose classification could not be proven covered by any named dedicated consumer -- resolved to AMBIGUOUS rather than an unproven APPLICATION_OR_LEGAL_GATE, and surfaced here so it can never simply disappear from every consequential view.

extraction_mode.description: V1 requires a structured extraction payload. This milestone does not call paid model APIs.

role_status.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied role freshness classification (schemas/job.schema.json, Blueprint Section 20/21), passed through unchanged. Null when not supplied by the caller -- never fabricated as VERIFIED_LIVE.

source_verification_status.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied direct-source verification axis (schemas/job.schema.json, Blueprint Section 19), passed through unchanged and independently of role_status. Null when not supplied.

date_last_verified.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied most-recent verification date, passed through unchanged. No freshness-threshold or date-arithmetic logic is applied to it. Null when not supplied.
